declared_conventions.ambient_control: For retained field cutoff L, the full-before-project control differentiates H_phi in an ambient coefficient space through L+max(deg N,deg M), then substitutes all ambient modes above L to zero; the L-only bracket is a separately declared projected calculation.
declared_conventions.background: q_ab=a^2 gamma_ab with a>0 spatially constant; theta and xi are canonical scalar configuration and momentum coefficients in phi=sum theta_n Q_n and pi_phi=sqrt(gamma) sum xi_n Q_n
declared_conventions.canonical_bracket: {theta_i,xi_j}=delta_ij and all theta-theta and xi-xi brackets vanish
declared_conventions.geometry: unit round S3, Vol=2*pi^2, Q_n=U_n(cos chi)/sqrt(2*pi^2), Delta Q_n=-n(n+2)Q_n, and integral Q_i Q_j=delta_ij
declared_conventions.hard_cutoff: The residual full-before-project minus L-only is a finite scalar-mode projection remainder. It is recorded with support and must not be called a continuum algebra failure, a classical anomaly or a quantum anomaly.
declared_conventions.hh_target: {H_phi[N],H_phi[M]}=D_phi[v_NM] with v_NM^a=a^(-2)(N D^a M-M D^a N)
declared_conventions.matter_constraints: H_phi[N]=(1/2) integral sqrt(gamma) N[a^(-3) xi^2+a |D theta|^2], D_phi[v]=integral sqrt(gamma) xi v^a D_a theta
